originalTitle: US Stock Market: Wall Street divided on Fed as rising crude prices boost rate hike expectations
simplifiedContent: The US Federal Reserve, which controls interest rates, is having a meeting and it's becoming harder to guess what they will decide. This is because oil prices are going up and there are worries about inflation, which is when prices for things like food and housing increase. Some experts think the Fed might raise interest rates, which would affect the stock market, but most still think rates will stay the same. The possibility of a rate hike is now considered more likely, which is making investors pay attention. This matters because changes to interest rates can impact the overall stock market and economy.

originalTitle: Tata Power shares get Equal Weight rating from Morgan Stanley with target price of Rs 399
simplifiedContent: Morgan Stanley, a big investment company, took a look at Tata Power's latest financial results and decided to keep its rating the same, which is called "Equal Weight". This means they think the company's stock is okay, but not exceptionally good or bad. They also think the stock's price will reach Rs 399 in the future. Even though Tata Power had some good news, like making more profit and spending a lot on new projects, its stock price actually went down. This is interesting because you might expect the stock price to go up when a company is doing well, but that's not what happened here.

originalTitle: From AI boom to valuation worries: Why investors are rethinking big tech bets
simplifiedContent: Some big tech companies, especially those that make computer chips like Nvidia, have been performing really well lately due to the growing use of artificial intelligence (AI). However, investors are now getting a bit worried that these companies might be overvalued, meaning their stock prices are too high. This worry, combined with concerns about spending on infrastructure and competition from China, has caused some investors to sell their shares, leading to a decrease in stock price. As a result, Apple has become the most valuable listed company again, as investors are shifting their focus to companies with more stable and predictable earnings. This change shows that investors are becoming more cautious and seeking safer investments.

originalTitle: Manipal Health Enterprises IPO: GMP, dates, price band, other key details in 10 points
simplifiedContent: Manipal Health Enterprises is about to launch a big stock market offering, called an Initial Public Offering (IPO), worth ₹9,275 crore. This means the company is trying to raise a large amount of money by selling its shares to the public. The IPO will start on July 29 and will involve the company issuing new shares as well as some existing shareholders selling their shares. The company will issue 13.56 crore new shares and some existing shareholders will sell 2.16 crore shares. This IPO is important because it allows the company to raise money and also gives investors a chance to buy shares in the company.

originalTitle: Varun Beverages Q2 Results: Net profit rises 15% to  ₹1,525 crore, revenue up 20%; dividend declared
simplifiedContent: Varun Beverages, a company that makes and sells beverages, just released its financial results for the second quarter of 2026. The company's net profit (or how much money it made) increased by 15% to ₹1,525 crore. Its revenue (or how much money it brought in from sales) also went up by 20% to ₹8,451 crore. The company's board of directors decided to give its shareholders a dividend, which is like a bonus payment, of 25%. This is good news for investors who own shares of Varun Beverages, as it shows the company is performing well financially.

originalTitle: Xtranet Technologies IPO allotment to be finalised today. Here's GMP, how to check status
simplifiedContent: Xtranet Technologies, a company that recently had an Initial Public Offering (IPO), will finalize who gets its shares today. An IPO is when a company first sells its shares to the public. The company's shares are currently being traded informally, or "on the grey market", and are selling for ₹7.5 more than their original price. This means that people are willing to pay extra to buy these shares, which could be a sign that they think the company will do well. The fact that the shares are in demand and selling at a premium may indicate a positive start for the company's stock market journey.
